snippet.title: Chunky JUMP! × Garten of Banban – Trailer
snippet.description:
😺WISHLIST CHUNKY JUMP! ON STEAM😺
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606780/Chunky_JUMP/

📢JOIN THE COMMUNITY 📢 (please read rules before joining)
https://discord.gg/thebunnygraveyard

The prophecy has finally come true… Garten of Banban has crashed into Chunky JUMP! Play as Banban, Jumbo Josh, Syringeon, Nabnab, Banbaleena, Bittergiggle, or Toadster in these brand-new Garten-themed levels, exclusive to Endless Mode. More details about this mode will be revealed in the future, so stay tuned! Special thanks to the Euphoric Brothers for trusting us with their colorful cast of characters for this crossover event.

What is Chunky JUMP?

A new short horror adventure in the world of The Bunny Graveyard—perfect for new and returning players! Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

FEATURES
• Story Mode – Discover Carrot Town’s mysteries and meet new characters.
• Endless Mode – A chaotic rogue-like experience where anything can happen.
• Collect Skins for Chunky and encounter new and familiar faces.
• Customize Your BIRD BOY with different colors.
• Hard Mode – Tougher monsters, fewer resources, more “game crashes,” and extra challenges.

#indiegames #chunkyjump #gartenofbanban #pixelart #indiehorror #crossover
